description:
## v1.1.1 — fixed bundle: ships classes.dex + Ed25519 signature

**This release fixes "source contains 0 patches" in Morphe Manager.** The v1.1.0 and v1.1.0 assets were plain JVM JARs — Morphe Manager loads patch bundles from their `classes.dex` and refuses bundles without one ("Patch bundle is missing dex entries"), so the source showed 0 patches. The DEX was compiled but a follow-up Gradle invocation re-ran the `jar` task (its manifest embeds a fresh build timestamp, so it never stays up-to-date) and overwrote the dex-merged bundle before it was uploaded.

### What changed
- The bundle now contains **`classes.dex`** (D8, min API 26) alongside the JVM classes, exactly like the official Morphe patches bundle — 5 patches load in Morphe Manager on Android and Morphe Desktop.
- The bundle is **signed** (`MorpheSig1` Ed25519, per the Morphe patch-bundle signature scheme). Public key committed as `morphe-signing.pub`; key fingerprint `2aad 189e 985d 5161`. First install pins the signer; later bundles must carry the same signature.
- No patch logic changed — the patched output is byte-identical to the verified v1.1.0 output on Opera stable 103 (4/4 compatible patches succeed headlessly; the GX patch applies to GX bundles only).

### Patches
- **Disable ad modules** (Opera & Opera Beta): breaks the reflective class lookup for the bundled Liftoff/Vungle, Mintegral and Pangle/ByteDance ad SDK modules.
- **Remove sponsored Speed Dial** (Opera & Opera Beta): neutralizes the suggested-sites partner_data / partner_tree / domain_data queries, so sponsored tiles never load.
- **Disable Acceptable Ads whitelist** (Opera & Opera Beta): replaces the hidden pure-whitelist filter lists in assets/abp_files/op/ with empty compiled lists.
- **Hide broken installation dialog** (Opera & Opera Beta): no-ops the crash-recovery nag described in v1.1.0 (evidence/ANALYSIS.md §5).
- **Remove sponsored Speed Dial** (Opera GX): strips operagx.gg affiliate / realUrl partner entries from the preloaded start page.

### Import
Add as patch source: https://morphe.software/add-source?github=maniesh-NR/Vogelkop-MorphePatches
